  PROBLEM: The self-escalation suppression gate (`HEAL_SELF_ESCALATED`, line 2449) and its comment (lines 2441-2446/2438-2450) treat any existing `ai:workflow-heal-escalated` label as proof that a CRITICAL alert was already sent, but the synced-security lineage cap (label at line 995, WARNING via `ss_level="WARNING"` lines 1090-1093) and the synced-check lineage cap (label at line 1191, `sc_level="WARNING"` line 1195, sent at 1260) send only WARNING.

All reviewers who rated it said MAJOR. sonnet and glm say the gating follows the issue and the fix is wording only (an accepted gap). luna frames it as a behavior defect. sonnet flags this file only as an optional comment fix.

- README.md lines 2145-2147 and changelog.d/9248-heal-escalation-alert-dedupe.md line 4 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The claim that every label-setting path "already sent its own CRITICAL alert" is wrong. The synced-file security lineage cap (label at line 995, `escalate)` case lines 990-1000) sends its one summary alert at line 1093 at `ss_level="WARNING"` (line 1091). The synced-file check lineage cap (label at line 1191, `sc_level="WARNING"` line 1195) alerts at 1260 at WARNING. Only the phase-path lineage cap (lines 2483-2494) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal_verify.sh line 688 send CRITICAL.
  WHY: A synced-cap-escalated issue that later self-fails sets HEAL_SELF_ESCALATED=true (intake line 2449), so its only possible CRITICAL becomes `escalate_repeat ... alert=suppressed`. The gating follows the plan; the defect is that the docs misstate coverage. Wording-only fix (about 4 lines). The intake comment at lines 2441-2446 should get the same clarification if touched.

- Refuted pass-1 claim (minimax_minimax-m3): the malformed-label cases in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py lines 6804-6812 do not suppress the alert. PAYLOAD_FILE is validate-payload output (intake lines 443-444), and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py line 2996 keeps only `isinstance(name, str)` entries, so the jq filter returns false and the alert is sent. Fail-open comes from the validator layer.
